today_summary: GCM26 marks $4,387.0, a +$54.4 (+1.26%) reclaim off Wednesday's $4,332.6 low that broke a five-session losing streak and never tested the $4,325 trigger flagged yesterday. Net GEX within +/-$200 rebuilt to +161.7 from +114.7 (+41%), but the entire cushion is two strikes above the market - $4,500 (+145.8) and $4,510 (+69.2) - while sub-spot gamma stays negative at -85.4. ATM IV firmed 23.74% -> 24.10% (+0.36pp), pricing a 1-sigma daily move of $66.6 (1.52%). Data vintage: 2026-09-17 session close; today's 06:50 BKK scrape had not posted at publication.
five_day_thesis: Five sessions on, price is essentially unchanged - $4,406.8 -> $4,387.0, just -$19.8 (-0.45%) - but the participation behind it has collapsed: call volume ran 24,999 -> 15,129 -> 9,127 -> 7,276 -> 6,626, a 73% drain, while put volume rose 2,468 -> 3,304 (+34%). That is the week's real signal, and it is defensive: the $4,332.6 low was bought, yet nobody paid up in calls to press the bounce. Open interest tells the same story from the other side - upside call stock is being retired ($6,000 -801, $4,900 -396, $4,800 -178) while put OI accumulated where it matters ($4,000 +389, $3,500 +304, $4,200 +231, total put OI +2,660 to 82,749). The dealer cushion that decayed 232.7 -> 114.7 into midweek has only partially healed to 161.7, and its composition is worse than its level: strip $4,500 and $4,510 and the local book reads -53.1, so dealers damp rallies into $4,500 and still accelerate breaks under $4,325. Both walls are pinned for a fifth straight session - put wall $3,500 (5,786), call wall $6,000 (17,676) - and max pain drifted only $5,600 -> $5,570, confirming the chain's structure is legacy, not fresh conviction in either direction.
what_changed: Spot reclaimed +$54.4 to $4,387.0, ending five consecutive lower prints and holding above the $4,325 short-gamma trigger
Call volume drained 73% over five sessions (24,999 -> 6,626) while put volume rose 34% (2,468 -> 3,304) - the bounce came without call sponsorship
Net GEX (+/-$200) recovered 114.7 -> 161.7 (+41%), but $4,500 and $4,510 supply 215 of it; ex-those strikes the local book is -53.1
Upside call OI retired across the board: $6,000 -801, $4,900 -396, $4,800 -178, with only $5,000 adding (+559)
Put OI built into the shelf beneath spot: $4,000 +389, $3,500 +304, $4,200 +231; total put OI +2,660 to 82,749
ATM IV firmed 23.74% -> 24.10% (+0.36pp), the first meaningful vol bid of the week, lifting the 1-sigma day to $66.6
prediction: Bias neutral with an upward drift while $4,325 holds. Positive gamma at $4,500/$4,510 makes that strike a fade zone rather than a breakout level, so the path of least resistance is a grind into $4,450-$4,500 and rejection, not a trend. Losing $4,325 re-enters the negative-gamma pocket - $4,300 (-27.4), $4,250 (-14.9), $4,200 (-23.8) - and reopens $4,200 with no dealer bid in between.

day_trade_cta.entry_note: Buy dips into the $4,340-$4,375 band where sub-spot gamma turns least negative, with the $4,325 shelf as the reference low. Do not chase strength into $4,500.
day_trade_cta.pivot_note: Sustained trade above $4,450 opens the $4,500 wall test and $4,510 (+69.2 GEX). Sustained trade below keeps rotation toward $4,325 and the $4,300 put shelf (3,415 contracts).
day_trade_cta.stop_note: -0.9% from entry midpoint, just under the $4,325 gamma trigger. Below it dealers flip short gamma and the $4,200 concentration becomes the magnet.
day_trade_cta.target_note: T1 $4,450 - the upper third of the range, take 50% off. T2 $4,500 - the dominant call wall and largest positive-gamma strike; exit remaining, do not hold through it.
day_trade_cta.risk_note: Net GEX +161.7 within +/-$200 damps directional follow-through; 1-sigma day is $66.6 (1.52%). Fade extremes, size normally, but cut fast below $4,325 where the cushion inverts.
